cases.question: Invoice Total的合计是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS 总Total FROM Invoice

cases.question: Invoice的订单数是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS InvoiceId FROM Invoice

cases.question: Invoice的平均Total是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(Total) AS 平均Total FROM Invoice

cases.question: 按BillingCountry统计Invoice Total
cases.gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry,SUM(Total) AS Total FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry

cases.question: 2009年Invoice Total是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS Total FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2009-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2010-01-01'

cases.question: 2010年按月统计Invoice Total
cases.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',InvoiceDate) AS 月份,SUM(Total) AS Total FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2010-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2011-01-01' GROUP BY 1

cases.question: Invoice Total按BillingCountry排名
cases.gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry,SUM(Total) AS Total FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY Total DESC,BillingCountry ASC

cases.question: 按Customer City统计Invoice Total
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.City,SUM(i.Total) AS Total FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId=c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.City

cases.question: 按Genre Name统计Track Milliseconds的平均值
cases.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name,AVG(t.Milliseconds) AS 平均Milliseconds FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId=g.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name

cases.question: 按MediaType Name统计Track Bytes的平均值
cases.gold_sql: SELECT m.Name,AVG(t.Bytes) AS 平均Bytes FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId=m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name

cases.question: 按Genre Name统计InvoiceLine Quantity的合计
cases.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name,SUM(il.Quantity) AS 总Quantity FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId=t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId=g.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name

cases.question: 各BillingCountry的Invoice Total高于平均
cases.gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry,SUM(Total) AS Total FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry HAVING SUM(Total) > (SELECT AVG(s) FROM (SELECT SUM(Total) AS s FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry))
